_about: Battle Brothers' fifteen origins, from the wiki dump (the Origins index at reference/library/grok/wiki/CORE_WIKITEXT.md:342-394 (the Origins index); the Lone Wolf page in CORE_WIKITEXT.md; the other fourteen pages in PAGES_ALL.tar.gz bb_all/), each with our skin (name and line, draft:true, his to rename). men: the starting company, one row per man (background = a backgrounds.json id; level = the page's stated level, null where the page states none, so the background's own starting range applies). crowns: the page's High/Medium/Low funds; batteries = crowns / 10 (rule 75a, 'batteries at 10 crowns to 1'); the door's shelves pick the column (FULL = High, THIN = Medium, BARE = Low). roster_cap and field_cap: the page's when it changes them, else Battle Brothers' default (20 in the roster, 12 in a fight). pay: OURS, not Battle Brothers': batteries added to every job's pay (the door's 10/2 card). rules: the page's own words; only the company, the caps and the start money are built (10/5); the rest is quoted for the lanes that build it.

roster_cap.quote: Has only 12 instead of 20 slots in the roster
